title: USA: New York, Vegas & the Grand Canyon
summary: Manhattan's energy, a night on the Strip, and sunrise at the rim of the Grand Canyon — the classic first look at America, coast to desert.
highlights: The Manhattan skyline from a Statue of Liberty ferry
Sunrise at the Grand Canyon's South Rim
A night on the Las Vegas Strip
Broadway and Central Park in one weekend
